source_rechecks.audit26-tian-discourse: Published ACL PDF page 8 (printed 17666), Table 6 extracted with pypdf and visually inspected after rendering with pypdfium2; arXiv HTML v2 agrees. Overall 23/9/68; Character 23/27/50.
source_rechecks.review28-storyscope: Primary HTML v1 abstract, methods/data and narrative-feature discussion inspected. Human corpus is Books3-derived; mirrored prompts and model-based features do not validate interventions or classify this repository.
source_rechecks.review28-antislop: Primary HTML v1 section 4 inspected: sequence/regex suppression; waiting for a full sequence avoids prefix bans, not semantic literal/quotation false positives.
source_rechecks.review28-litbench: Primary ACL abstract inspected: Reddit-derived training/test pairs; 73% strongest OTS and 78% trained reward-model results are task-specific, not ceilings.
source_rechecks.review28-storyalign: Primary arXiv abstract inspected: 1,133 instances with one chosen and three rejected stories; 66.3% best existing reward model is not directly comparable to every pairwise task.
source_rechecks.review28-rating-roulette: Primary ACL abstract rechecked for run-to-run instability. No fixed k>=3 or temperature policy is inferred; prior temperature detail was not independently rechecked here.
source_rechecks.review28-correlated-errors: Primary arXiv record reopened; cross-vendor correlation motivates local measurement, not guaranteed independence.
source_rechecks.review28-pds: Primary ACL abstract inspected: alpha .72 and model-human correlations; also reports GPT-4 matching/exceeding highly rated Reddit stories on studied measures. Not a universal literary merit instrument.
source_rechecks.review28-alt-test: Primary arXiv v4 abstract inspected. Annotation replacement under tested conditions does not by itself authorize a creative promotion veto.
source_rechecks.review28-git-update-ref: Official documentation reopened. Conditional old-value ref update can implement CAS; domain-level acceptance/reachability checks remain necessary.
